batting.dismissal: c JM Sharma b JR Hazlewood

balls.text: Iyer with a sumptuous stroke to take RCB past 200! Back of a length outside off. Iyer picks the length early, uses his long levers and thumps it over long off. Some finish to the innings, and RCB have made it past 200!
bashed half-way down and well outside off. Iyer fetches it and drop-kicks it off the top edge into the square leg region. Back for another brace
another attempted wide yorker but this is beyond the tramlines. Left alone and called a wide
slower bumper banged in short outside off. Iyer jumps up onto his toes and flat-bats it over extra cover for a couple of runs
excellent wide yorker, hugging the tramlines on the off side. Iyer looks to sweep and misses it. Touch-and-go on the wide. Not given on the field. Not reviewed either
Iyer comes to the party, finally! Back of a length just outside off. Iyer gets his front hip out of the way and wallops it over deep mid wicket!
starts the over with a boundary! Back of a length outside off. Iyer brings out the reverse and helps it fine past short third!

full toss on middle and leg. Bhuvneshwar is late on it and cloths it to long on. Iyer puts on his skates, trying to get back for the second and makes it. Just. They took on Hetmyer and got the designated batter back on strike
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Iyer chalks it into the cover region and picks up a run
back of a length on middle and off. Bhuvneshwar punches it down the ground to long on
shot! Shortish outside off and this sits up nicely. Bhuvneshwar stands up tall and bashes it past extra cover!
slower bumper outside off. Bhuvneshwar decides a week early he wants to duck under it and does so eventually
very full on middle and leg. Iyer jams it back past the bowler. Brijesh will feel he should have stopped that
back of a length outside off. Iyer stands up on his toes and knocks it to long off
back of a length just outside off. Bhuvneshwar goes back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Bhuvneshwar gets behind the line and turns it towards mid wicket
length outside off. Iyer wafts at it and chunks it off the inside edge towards short fine leg

length just outside off. Bhuvneshwar wants to drop and run to Jadeja at point. He gets sent back and Jadeja's throw misses its mark too. Ferreira fumbles on the back-up, and Iyer does get back on strike
length ball sneaking down leg. Bhuvneshwar does not get bat on it and the umpire calls it a wide

Sandeep induces the miscue, and Patidar departs! Zipped in full on leg, and this seems to just stick in the surface slightly. Patidar a shade early into his slog and the ball skews up off the bottom part of the blade. Only gets the elevation he wants and Ferreira does the rest at deep mid wicket. A stunning knock, although someone else will now have to take RCB past 200!
hung up full and wide outside off. Iyer throws his hands at it and drills it past extra cover. Jadeja tears across to his left on the fence sprawls to his left and saves two
back of a lenght on off. Iyer goes back and stabs it towards the bowler
darted in on a length outside off. Patidar tries to hit it too hard and shanks it to long on
fetch that too, says Patidar! This is a drag-down on off. Patidar spots it early, opens up his stance and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
this is another mighty hit! Patidar is having a ball out there! Fired into the slot just outside off. Patidar plants his front foot and smokes it over the bowler's head!
shortish outside off. Iyer reaches out for it and scuffs it towards deep point
slower ball on a length outside off. Patidar waits for it before driving it on the up towards extra cover
glorious way to get to his half-century! Misses the off-stump yorker by a smidgen, and Patidar climbs into it. Gets his hands through the ball and creams it past extra cover!
slower ball, dug in short on middle and off. Cramps Patidar for room and he can only plonk it back towards the bowler
fuller just outside off. Patidar goes inside-out again and chips it over extra cover for a couple of runs
oh dear! Slower ball on a length outside off. Patidar throws his hands at it and flays it towards sweeper cover, where Bishnoi makes an absolute meal of it. Beaten by the second-bounce spin!
back of a length outside off. Iyer hops up onto his toes and punches it to long off
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Patidar hangs back and pokes it towards the bowler
Patidar turning on the style now! Half-tracker on middle and off, and this sits up. Patidar lifts up his front leg, uses his wrists and pummels it a mile over deep square leg!
oh! Back of a length just outside off. Patidar has a wild mow across the line and the ball straightens just enough to go past his swinging blade
take that, says the RCB skipper! Right in the slot outside off. Patidar plants his front foot and bangs it over mid off. Flat hit over the fence!
dug in short outside off. Iyer gets up on his toes and hacks it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Patidar tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket

oh, this goes way up, touches the moon, and is taken on the second attempt! Pushed in on a length just outside leg. Stops in the surface, though, and Shepherd makes a meal of his swipe. The ball goes straight up off the top edge and Brijesh, stood at short fine leg, reacts in time to catch the bobble, having spilled the chance at the first time of asking. RCB seven down now!
a tad slower, on a fullish length on off. Patidar has a slog at it and drags it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and off. Shepherd stays back and knocks it to long off
darted in again, tucking up the batter. Patidar helps it towards deep mid wicket
tossed up a touch, fullish on middle and off. Shepherd prods it past the bowler
angled in full on leg. Shepherd gets down on one knee and heaves it behind square. Good work by Archer on the fence to save two
full outside off. Shepherd comes onto the front foot and pushes it towards sweeper cover
four more! Slower yorker goes wrong and sneaks down leg. Shepherd uses the angle and tickles it past short fine leg!
brilliantly done! Short and wide outside off. Shepherd waits on it and knifes it perfectly between short third and backward point!
slanted in on a length on middle and off. Pushed down the ground to long off
that is a serious shot! Half-tracker outside off. Patidar stands up tall and slaps it disdainfully over the bowler's head!
dug in short on leg. Shepherd gets inside the line and pulls it on the bounce to fine leg
leg-spinner on a length just outside off. Shepherd comes forward and jabs it towards sweeper cover
slanted into the pads again. Eased out to deep mid wicket
back of a length, angling into the pads. Shepherd stabs it towards deep square leg

oh, hello! What is this pressure you all are talking about, says Shepherd! Floated up full just outside off. Seems like the googly. Does not matter to Shepherd, though. He plants his front foot and launches it over long off!
fired in full on off. Patidar comes forward and knocks it to long on
googly on a length on middle and leg. Patidar looks to sweep but misses, with the ball bobbling off his pad into the on side

straight down Hetmyer's throat, and David falls too! Slower ball bashed half-way down the track. It is so slow and so short that it barely gets to David. He still tries to muscle it but cannot muster the requisite elevation. Hits it flat to long on, and Brijesh, just like that, has two!
slanted in on a length on middle and leg. Patidar has a slog across the line and misses, with the ball rolling off the pad into the off side
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Punched down the ground to long on
back of a length on off. Patidar rises with the bounce and pushes it towards long on
off-pace and into the track outside off. David tries to hit it too hard and shanks it to long on
length outside off. Patidar plants his front foot and punches it towards deep point
back of a length on middle and off. David gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side
David with another boundary! Banged in short again, just outside off. David stands up tall and muscles it over mid wicket!
sharp bumper on middle and off, bowled at 139.4kph. David gets into a bit of a tangle but manages to fend it towards the bowler
oh! Back of a length on off and this seams away. Patidar gets squared up and the ball rolls off the outside edge towards deep third
hard length on middle and off. David opens his bat face and taps it into the point region
full outside off. Patidar comes forward and square-drives it crisply towards deep point
loose ball and put away! Too easy for David. Full and sliding well down leg. All David has to do is get bat on it and he does so without much hassle!
gentle full toss outside off. David gets a stride in and drives it past extra cover. Off the mark with a couple of runs

rapped on the pad, and on your way, says the ump! Jitesh chats to his skipper and then opts against the review. Back of a length on middle, and this nips in a touch. Keeps a tad low too and Jitesh cannot get his bat down in time. Pinned right in front and this seems like a good decision to not review. RCB five down now!
back of a length just outside off. Patidar gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep mid wicket
dug in short and wide. Jitesh throws his hands at it and slashes it down to deep third
full outside off. Patidar plants his front foot and drills it towards sweeper cover
fired in on a length on off. Patidar comes forward and knocks it to long on
back of a length, angling into the pads. Jitesh tucks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Straightens a touch and Jitesh prods it back to the bowler
darted in, cramping the batter for room on middle and leg. Patidar pokes it to long on
Patidar greets Jadeja with a boundary! Length ball on middle and off. Patidar gives himself room and chips it beautifully over extra cover. Lands just in front of the rope!
tossed up full on leg. Jitesh gets close enough to the ball and eases it to deep mid wicket
slower and fuller on leg. Jitesh comes onto the front foot and works it towards deep mid wicket
on a length just outside off. Patidar gets onto the front foot and drives it on the up to long off
back of a length on middle and leg. Jitesh dinks it into the mid wicket region and opens his account
fullish outside off. Jitesh stretches forward and defends

Hetmyer lunges forward, and he gobbles up another sharp grab! Given a hint of air just outside off. Krunal takes a step down and tries to go over long off. Slices across it, though, and does not get the elevation he wants. Arrows it flat to long off, where Hetmyer tumbles forward and takes it well above the turf. Bishnoi has two, and RCB four down now!
speared in full on middle and leg. Patidar knocks it to long on
slower short ball on middle and leg. Patidar hops up onto his toes and drops it into the mid wicket region to keep strike
back of a length outside off. Krunal opens his bat face and slices it towards deep backward point
oh! Back of a length in the channel and this seems to leave the batter very late. Krunal nibbles at it and is beaten all ends up!
banged in short, just outside off. Krunal looks to play the upper-cut but is beaten for pace
shortish outside off. Krunal hangs back and jabs it straight to point
length on off. Patidar presses forward and taps it into the point region
googly on a fullish length on leg. Krunal comes forward and blocks

Bishnoi does Kohli all ends up, and Kohli has to walk! Beautifully-disguised googly, on a length just outside off. Dips on Kohli late and he is nowhere to the pitch of the ball as he looks to go inside-out. The ball rips in, goes past Kohli's flailing blade and crashes into the stumps. Bishnoi holds his arms aloft, and why shouldn't he. He has deceived Kohli completely here!
back of a length on off. Patidar opens up his stance and powers it on the bounce to long on
pushed in full on the pads. Kohli comes forward and glances it towards short fine leg, who tumbles to his left and keeps it to one
back of a length outside off. Kohli chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards the bowler

huge, huge lbw appeal, not given! There is a run-out chance to boot too. Angled in full on leg. Patidar misses his slog and gets struck on the back leg. Seemed to be heading down and RR decide against it at the last moment. While that was happening, Patidar was scrambling to get to the other end and might have been in trouble with a direct hit. Ball Tracking confirms the ball would have spun past leg!
the Kohli cover drive is out now! Right in the slot outside off. Kohli leans into the drive and threads it between extra cover and mid off!
up and over! Back of a length on middle and off. Kohli steps out to the leg side, holds his shape and lifts it over mid off!
back of a length just outside off. Patidar stands tall on the front foot and punches it to long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Patidar lets the ball come to him before stabbing it to mid wicket
hard length, zoning into middle and off. No room to work with as such and Patidar plays it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg. Kohli gives himself room before patting it to long on

in the air, and Hetmyer redeems himself! Hard length on middle and leg. Sticks in the surface and Padikkal, trying to pick it up, shanks it a mile up. Hetmyer, initially running in from deep square, holds his position and has to then lunge forward at the last moment. Does so with aplomb, and Archer, after taking a bit of tap, has his second!
back of a length outside off. Kohli hangs back and jabs it into the extra cover region

this is superb batting! RR rummaging for answers. Kohli throwing multiple different questions at them. This is on a back of a length again, outside off. Kohli uses the pace and guides it between short third and backward point!
four more! Banged in short but this is sliding down leg. Kohli, despite backing away a touch initially, has enough room to help it past fine leg!
back of a length just outside off. Kohli gets behind the line of the ball and defends
smartly done! Back of a length outside off. Kohli stays on top of the bounce and opens his bat face to steer it between backward point and short third!
hard length outside off. Kohli drops it into the off side and saunters across to the other end

goodness me! Back of a length just outside off and this decks back in sharply. Kohli gets cut in half and the movement is so extravagant that the keeper is wrong-footed too. In Jurel's defence, that moved away a bit after passing the bat too. RCB will not care one bit, though. Replays indicate that the ball grazed the inside edge. Jurel was nowhere near getting to it, however.

oh dear - RR leaking runs now! Back of a length on leg and this swings further down. Kohli does not get bat on it and Jurel, diving to his left, cannot get enough of his glove to it. Five bonus runs for RCB!
trademark Virat Kohli! Length ball, shaping in a touch towards middle and leg. Kohli plants his front foot and whips it behind square. One bounce and into the long leg fence!
jaffa! Back of a length in the channel and this continues with the angle. A bit of nip away and Kohli, nibbling at it, is beaten on the outside
dug into the track outside off. Padikkal hacks it into the mid wicket region and has to settle for a single
shot! Back of a length outside off. Padikkal gets on top of the bounce and cracks it on the up through point!

edged and four again! Archer will not be best pleased with this either. On a back of a length outside off. Kohli goes feeling for it and gets a thick outside edge that hurtles to the keeper's right. Slip was in place but it was too wide to have any chance. RCB get 13 off the first!
back of a length on middle and leg. Padikkal lets the ball come to him before glancing it down to fine leg
shorter, wider and punished! Plenty of width on offer. Padikkal jumps up onto his toes and slashes it over backward point!
edged and four! Back of a length and in that probing corridor just outside off. Padikkal nibbles at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies past second slip!
peach! Back of a length in the channel and this jags away after pitching. Padikkal gets squared up and gets beaten comprehensively

a brute of a delivery, and Salt is outta here! This is an absolute snorter and Salt has no idea on how to react. On middle stump and this keeps climbing through. Salt cannot get out of the way and the ball pings near the handle of the bat. Simple catch for Jurel, and RCB have been stunned early!

that will be that! Jurel fittingly finishes the run-chase, and the Royals have cantered past the defending champions! Back of a length outside off. Jurel eases it down to long on, and that sums up how this run-chase has been, especially after the powerplay pyrotechnics. Clinical from Jurel, and RR go 4-0 to begin their season!
dumped into the stands, and scores are now level! Juicy full toss outside leg and Jurel capitalizes. He snaps his wrists into play and shovels it over deep backward square leg!
safe! Another short ball outside off. Jadeja looks for the upper-cut and picks out deep third on the bounce
dragged down on the stumps. Jurel heaves it towards deep mid wicket. RR inch closer to their target
back of a length outside off. Jadeja waits deep in his crease and cuts it down to deep third
dug in short outside off. Jurel stands up on his toes and hacks it to deep mid wicket
length just outside off. Jurel drives it on the up to long on and retains strike
on a length and hidden wide outside off. Jurel leaves it go and the umpire says it is fine. RR go upstairs. Just inside the tramlines and the original call stays!
angled in full on off. Jurel steps down the track and drives it to long on. Jurel wants the second. Jadeja initially says no but a misfield by Bethell allows the second run
back of a length on middle and leg. Jadeja pushes it into the wide long on region. Settles for a single this time
back of a length outside off. Jurel knocks it down to long on rather calmly
back of a length just outside off. Jurel hops up onto his toes and works it perfectly between deep mid wicket and deep square leg
shortish just outside off. Jurel hacks it to deep mid wicket and keeps strike
length on middle and off. Jurel gets a half stride in and drives it crisply past the non-striker. Back for another brace
dug in short on middle and off. Jadeja gives himself just enough room and glides it uppishly to deep third
full outside off. Jurel throws his hands at it and drives it towards sweeper cover
short and climbing through on off. Jadeja stays leg side of the ball and runs it down to deep third
shortish just outside off. Jurel opens up his stance and drills it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Jurel stands up tall and punches it to long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Jadeja drops it into the point region
a wide to the left-hander now. Full and sneaking down leg. Easy decision for the umpire once Jadeja misses it
dug in short just outside off. Jurel walks down the track and tugs it towards deep backward square leg
edged and four! Jurel continues to rattle along! Full and wide again. Jurel reaches out for it and gets a thick enough outside edge to beat the keeper to his right!
hung up full and way outside off. Left alone by Jurel and called a wide
this is another scorcher! Full and wide. Jurel gives himself ample room, frees his arms and laces it past backward point!
very full outside off. Jadeja jams down on it and squeezes it out towards fine leg
back of a length outside off. Jadeja uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
back of a length outside off. Jurel stays back and bunts it into the square leg region
a direct hit, and Jadeja was not even in the frame! Shortish just outside off. Jadeja tips it straight to Patidar at mid wicket and sets off. Jadeja was a mile short had Patidar found his mark!
back of a length on middle and leg. Jurel helps it behind square and brings up his second half-century this season. Another top knock by RR's number three!
this is a thunderous blow! Short on off. Jurel shimmies around before settling on leg. Picks up the length and belts it between deep square leg and fine leg!

big lbw shout, not given! Back of a length delivery just outside leg. Skids through and raps Jadeja on the pad. Seemed to be heading into the stumps but may have pitched outside leg. RCB want to take a look nevertheless. No bat involved but Ball Tracking, as expected, shows the ball to be pitching well outside leg. Jadeja stays!
another attempted bouncer, but this sits up on middle and leg. Jadeja pulls it on the bounce to deep backward square leg
darted in on a back of a length outside off. Jadeja looks to reverse-lap it but fails to lay bat on ball. Was a seam-up ball again
back of a length outside off. Comes off a little slow and Jurel chops it into the point region
full outside off. Jurel gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it past extra cover for a couple of runs
length on middle and off. Jadeja sits back in his crease and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
streaky, but they still count! Back of a length on middle and off. Jadeja has a hurried stab at it and squirts it off the inside edge past short fine leg!
shortish and following the batter outside leg. Jadeja helps it towards deep square leg
back of a length on off. Jadeja rises with the bounce and turns it towards mid wicket
back of a length on the pads. Jadeja tucks it past mid wicket and is quick enough to saunter back for a brace
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja hangs back and jabs it back to the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Holds in the surface and Jadeja chunks it back to the bowler
back of a length just outside off. Jurel presses half forward and punches it to long on
half-tracker outside off. Jurel hops back and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length, angling into middle and off. Jurel stays back and chops it towards backward point
floated up full just outside off. Jadeja pats it back towards the bowler, who parries it to mid wicket. Jadeja continues with the run and makes it
another bumper but this is a touch down leg. Jadeja ducks under it. Second bouncer for the over
the bumper is out again. On middle and leg, and Jadeja, after being taken by surprise initially, does well to sway out of the way
tossed up full just outside off. Jadeja gets down on one knee and paddles it fine for a couple of runs
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja gets behind the line and pushes it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja hops up onto his toes and stabs it into the mid wicket region. Ball holds up near the edge of the ring, and both batters dash back for two

and something does give! Oh my, Parag bites the dust too! Hard length just outside off. Parag stands up tall and looks to shovel it over long on. Miscues it off the toe-end and that brings long on into play. Krunal moves to his right and snaffles up the chance. RCB going nowhere!
much shorter on middle and leg. Jurel swivels nicely and pulls it enough to deep square leg's right. Just a single, though. Not great running
shortish on middle and off, and this skids through. Jurel misses his short-arm-jab and gets struck in an area where it usually hurts...
back of a length just outside off. Parag gets up on his toes and pats it into the mid on region
very full on the pads. Parag dinks it into the mid wicket region. He contemplates the second but opts against it because Jitesh was swift off his mark to track it down
slowed up on a length on off. Parag lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
fullish on middle and off. Jurel comes forward and knocks it to long off
length just outside off. Parag comes half forward and pushes it to long off

oh dear, what have you done, Hetmyer?! Krunal welcomes Hetmyer with a bumper outside off. Hetmyer is so taken aback by it that he does not know what to do with it. He dangles his bat at the last moment and gives Hazlewood some catching practice at short third. Bizarre dismissal, but the RCB fans have now found their voice!

clothed to long on, and Sooryavanshi perishes! Back of a length outside off. Sooryavanshi winds up and has a huge swipe at it. Chunks it off the inside half of the bat, though, and the ball arrows to long on. Kohli lunges low to his left and does the rest. But the stadium and those at home collectively rise to their feet. An innings from out of this world, and those who witnessed it, will tell tales about it for years and years!
back of a length on off. Sooryavanshi waits for it and punches it to long on

much cleaner hit, and no prizes for guessing where this has landed! This is ridiculously good batting! Flighted up into the slot on leg. Sooryavanshi clears his front leg and smokes it over wide long on!
going, going, gone! Another drag-down, just outside off. This holds in the surface, though, and Sooryavanshi clinks it. But he still musters enough sauce to clear deep square leg!
angled in on a length on middle and off. Played back calmly to the bowler
pushed in on a length on middle and off. Jurel turns it towards deep mid wicket
and David gets greeted with a boundary as well! Half-tracker and laced with width. Jurel rocks back and cuts it fiercely behind point!
spin travels the distance too! Nothing matters to this boy! Right in the slot outside leg. Sooryavanshi picks it up and deposits it over deep square leg!
fired in full on the pads. Jurel helps it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on the pads. Sooryavanshi eases it out to deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Jurel stays back and knocks it to long on
shot! Dragged down on middle and off. Jurel rocks back, picks his spot and hammers it over mid wicket!
slowed up on a length on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
in the gap, and into the fence again! Shortish just outside off. Jurel gets on top of the bounce and blitzes it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!
buffet ball and parked into the stands! Knee-high full toss on leg stump. Jurel rubs his eyes in disbelief, shuffles across and hoists it into the top deck over fine leg!
length outside off. Jurel gets onto the front foot and punches it on the up towards cover
Jurel on fire too now! Back of a length outside off. Jurel peels the outer cover off the ball and knifes it between point and backward point!
flat as a tank! On a length outside off. Jurel plants his front foot, goes through the line and thumps it over the long on fence!
Jurel wants a piece of the fun too! Shortish and straying onto the hips. Jurel has a swipe at it and gets it past short fine leg!
stop that, Sooryavanshi! Banged in short on middle and off. Sooryavanshi gives himself room and ramps it over short third without a care in the world!
slower ball on a length on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi checks his shot just in time and plays it back to the bowler
low full toss on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi pokes it towards mid off

oh, this goes a mile up, and it has just enough on it! Yet another 15-ball half-century for thi 15-year-old. Bashed in short just outside off. Gets up high and Sooryavanshi top-edges his pull. Salt catches it at long leg but he also steps onto the cushion while doing so. What a knock. What a player. Full stop.
Sooryavanshi takes on Bhuvneshwar too now! Banged in short outside off. Sooryavanshi stands up tall and whacks it over mid on!
length just outside off. Jurel tips it to mid off and scampers across to the other end
this keeps getting better! This boy is a star! Marginally short just outside off and Sooryavanshi says thank you very much. He picks it up and dumps it over the deep square leg fence!
does this boy not care for reputations?! Well, looks like he does not. Full outside off. Sooryavanshi gets his hands through the ball and cracks it between mid off and extra cover!
over the top again! Length ball on middle and off. Sooryavanshi clears his front leg and slams it over mid on!

what timing! This boy can play! Hard length on off. Sooryavanshi seems to get cramped up but he chops down on it with so much ferocity that the ball skips off the turf and beats deep backward point to his right!
back of a length outside off. Jurel opens his bat face and runs it down to short third, who fumbles and ends up conceding a single
length just outside off. Jurel gets a half stride in and drops it into the off side
this is simply outstanding! Full and speared into the pads. Sooryavanshi snaps his wrists into action and whips it over deep mid wicket!
shortish outside off. Jurel hangs back in his crease and chops it into the turf, with the ball bouncing up over backward point
fullish and shaping into middle and off. Sooryavanshi has a tug at it and drags it towards deep square leg
streaky but Sooryavanshi will take it! Back of a length just outside off. Sooryavanshi has a huge whoosh across the line and inside-edges it past the keeper!
smashed! Slower ball but this is right in the slot outside off. Sooryavanshi plants his front foot and blasts it back past the bowler!
on a length and finishing on leg. Might have pitched just outside, though. Sooryavanshi misses his flick and that lbw shout was only a polite enquiry, at best

nicked and gone! Hazlewood is back, and Jaiswal has to trudge off! Back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal has a pop at it but does not have enough room to work with. Only manages a healthy nick and Jitesh snares it smartly to his left. Hazlewood hands RR their first powerplay wicket of the season, and this opening stand has been thwarted inside two overs!
stunning. Just stunning! Fractionally short on middle and leg, and that is all Jaiswal needs. He opens up his front hip and thunders it over mid wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and taps it towards slip
back of a length just outside off and this zips through. Jaiswal wafts at it but is incredibly late on it
back of a length on middle and off. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and defends
Jaiswal welcomes Hazlewood with a maximum! Full and slanting across the batter outside off. Jaiswal frees his arms and scythes it over deep backward point!
up and over from Sooryavanshi! Hung up on a length wide outside off. Sooryavanshi throws the plumbing at it and carves it over point!
banged in shorter outside off and this skips through too. Sooryavanshi decides late that he wants to upper-cut it and is beaten for pace
shortish just outside off and this one skids through. Sooryavanshi is rushed on the pull and hacks it to mid wicket
off the mark with a boundary! Of course! In-swinging yorker on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi jams his bat down on time and squeezes it back past the bowler. Patidar, giving chase, cannot rein it in!
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal lets the ball come to him before guiding it towards deep backward point
back of a length just outside off. Shapes away a little and Jaiswal, hanging back, dabs it behind point. Slight hesitation between the batters but no damage done
